class: Former jobs checked as current and missing their end dates
symptom: Waystar showed all three employers as current, hiding end dates for two completed roles.
root_cause: A repeated job heading was treated as a checkbox choice group. The known No answer used choose, which selected the box. Existing checked boxes were skipped and split Month/Year labels did not identify From versus To. The legacy filler also checked only the first current box and never cleared former rows.
why_tests_missed: Employment tests used clearly named date fields and current-status select boxes rather than grouped checkboxes with conditional split dates.
fix: Use individual yes/no checkbox actions for repeated entries; correct a site-filled current flag through existing provenance rules; qualify date parts from their owning From/To group; scope the legacy current checkbox to its row.
prevention: Verify current flags and committed start/end dates per matched employer, including resumed prechecked rows and owner edits.
